title: Binary64 integer parity classifier
summary: Recovered cdecl classifier at VA 0x8fc420 (RVA 0x4fc420). Returns 0 for nonintegral or nonfinite values, 1 for odd finite integers, 2 for even finite integers including signed zero. Reads argument bits only. Direct calls at 0x8fcf9f and 0x8fd035 pass an eight-byte value and consume the integer result in numerical sign handling. No object fields, imports, or memory side effects.
test_description: Direct original comparison for signed zero, subnormals, signed finite values, odd/even integers, fractional values, infinities, signaling/quiet NaNs and payloads; all 2048 exponents with each fraction bit and endpoint mantissas under 16 MXCSR configurations; 100000 deterministic random bit patterns. Checks explicit expected classifications, unchanged argument and surrounding guards, and unchanged MXCSR after each call. Local GCC harness exited zero with oracle linked at 0x8fc420; all 133 oracle bytes compared equal to Game.exe. Supplied VS2013 compiler accepted implementation under O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: Implementation assumes little-endian IEEE-754 binary64 as used by original x86 and intended Linux/Windows targets.
Caller numerical algorithms are outside assigned scope; their full identities are not established.
No claim of matching original compiler output; no exception dispatch or OS behavior is involved.
